reply.text:
Workaround while the primary gateway is down: open Harbor, choose Settings, then Gateway, select gw2 (Backup) and press Connect. The backup gateway works on Windows and macOS and gives access to the file share and the ERP.

Error 809 means the Harbor client cannot reach the primary gateway, gw1. When one person sees it, the cause is usually their home router blocking the tunnel. When many remote employees see it at the same time, the primary gateway itself is unavailable and the network team must restore it. Reinstalling the client or rebooting the laptop does not help.
